title: Old clarinetists, Zeb, and closing
summary: The interviewer asks about early clarinetists; Howard names Miller Bonds and Zeb, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I think, and we might ask if there's any other old-time clarinetists. I mean, we know George, and I've heard all the later fellas, but amongst the old timers, were there any, like George or Boyd? Do you remember him? Yeah.
Yes, you boy, sure too. Were there any others about that time that are dead that you were your favorites? Oh, Miller Bonds was real good.
One of the good ones. Yeah, he was one of the good ones, too. Zeb. Zeb, I don't know much about his name.
Well, he used to play with Renee.
Was he really good? Do you remember his real name?
All I know was Zeb. That's all it got him. Zeb, something like that.
You played with him then, too, I suppose, at times? Well, yeah, we had played together.
Well, I think that covers almost all of your life pretty well. I want to thank you for all . Okay, dear. Okay.
